title: 病院での口語表現と聞き返し

items.en: Hey, Mara, the waiting room's packed. Did they say how long it'll be?
items.jp: ねえマラ、待合室がいっぱいだね。どれくらいかかるって？
items.speak: Hey, Mara, the waiting room's packed. Did they say how long it'll be?

items.en: I dunno. The front desk said they'd call my name.
items.jp: 分からないな。受付では名前を呼ぶと言ってたよ。
items.speak: I dunno. The front desk said they'd call my name.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:分からない時

items.en: Maya, can you hold my place while I get some water?
items.jp: マヤ、水を取ってくる間、場所を取っておいてくれる？
items.speak: Maya, can you hold my place while I get some water?

items.en: The nurse said the doctor'll be with you soon.
items.jp: 看護師さんが、もうすぐ医師が来ると言ってたよ。
items.speak: The nurse said the doctor will be with you soon.
items.note: 元の形: doctor will／聞こえ方: ドクターゥル／使う場面:予定を伝える

items.en: Hey, doc, could you say that one more time a little slower?
items.jp: 先生、もう一度少しゆっくり言っていただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, doc, could you say that one more time a little slower?

items.en: I gotta write this down before I forget.
items.jp: 忘れる前に書き留めなきゃ。
items.speak: I gotta write this down before I forget.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: アイガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: Hey, Jen, the pharmacist said to call if anything feels off.
items.jp: ねえジェン、薬剤師さんが、何か気になることがあれば電話してって。
items.speak: Hey, Jen, the pharmacist said to call if anything feels off.

items.en: Gimme a second; I'm pulling up the appointment text.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。予約のメッセージを開いてる。
items.speak: Gimme a second; I'm pulling up the appointment text.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: Sir, do you know where the lab is?
items.jp: すみません、検査室がどこかご存じですか？
items.speak: Sir, do you know where the lab is?

items.en: Lemme check the floor map with you.
items.jp: 一緒にフロア案内を確認させて。
items.speak: Lemme check the floor map with you.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:手伝う時

items.en: Hey, buddy, you don't have to tough it out alone.
items.jp: ねえ、ひとりで我慢しなくていいんだよ。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, you don't have to tough it out alone.

items.en: The clinic's running late, but they haven't forgotten you.
items.jp: 診察は遅れてるけど、あなたのことを忘れてはいないよ。
items.speak: The clinic's running late, but they haven't forgotten you.

items.en: Hey, Nina, wanna sit by the window? It's quieter over there.
items.jp: ねえニナ、窓際に座る？あっちのほうが静かだよ。
items.speak: Hey, Nina, want to sit by the window? It's quieter over there.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に誘う

items.en: Sounds good. I need a little less noise right now.
items.jp: いいね。今はもう少し静かなところにいたい。
items.speak: Sounds good. I need a little less noise right now.

items.en: Hey, pharmacist, could you go over the label with me?
items.jp: 薬剤師さん、ラベルの内容を一緒に確認していただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, pharmacist, could you go over the label with me?

items.en: I was gonna ask about the side effects, but the line got busy.
items.jp: 副作用について聞こうと思ってたけど、列が混んできた。
items.speak: I was going to ask about the side effects, but the line got busy.
items.note: 元の形: was going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:予定の説明

items.en: Hey, Mom, the nurse wants to speak with you before we leave.
items.jp: ねえお母さん、帰る前に看護師さんが話したいって。
items.speak: Hey, Mom, the nurse wants to speak with you before we leave.

items.en: Okay, gimme the papers and I'll bring them over.
items.jp: 分かった。書類を渡して。持っていくね。
items.speak: Okay, give me the papers and I'll bring them over.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:物を頼む時

items.en: Hey, Alex, didja hear what time they want us back?
items.jp: ねえアレックス、何時に戻ってきてほしいって聞いた？
items.speak: Hey, Alex, did you hear what time they want us back?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:くだけた確認

items.en: Not exactly. Could you ask them to repeat it?
items.jp: はっきりとは。もう一度言ってもらえる？
items.speak: Not exactly. Could you ask them to repeat it?

items.en: Hey, boss, I need to step out for a medical appointment.
items.jp: すみません、診察のため少し席を外します。
items.speak: Hey, boss, I need to step out for a medical appointment.

items.en: No problem. Just let me know when you're back.
items.jp: 大丈夫。戻ったら知らせてね。
items.speak: No problem. Just let me know when you're back.

items.en: Hey, Liz, can you call the clinic and ask about the wait?
items.jp: ねえリズ、クリニックに電話して待ち時間を聞いてくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Liz, can you call the clinic and ask about the wait?

items.en: Sure thing. Hang on while I find their number.
items.jp: もちろん。番号を探すからちょっと待って。
items.speak: Sure thing. Hang on while I find their number.

items.en: Hey, buddy, you good? You got real quiet all of a sudden.
items.jp: ねえ、大丈夫？急にすごく静かになったね。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, are you good? You got real quiet all of a sudden.
items.note: 元の形: are you／聞こえ方: ユー／使う場面:様子を尋ねる

items.en: I'm okay, just trying to remember what the doctor said.
items.jp: 大丈夫。ただ、先生の話を思い出そうとしてる。
items.speak: I'm okay, just trying to remember what the doctor said.

items.en: Hey, Maya, could you come with me to the follow-up?
items.jp: ねえマヤ、再診に一緒に来てくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Maya, could you come with me to the follow-up?

items.en: Absolutely. Text me the time, and I'll be there.
items.jp: もちろん。時間をメッセージして。行くよ。
items.speak: Absolutely. Text me the time, and I'll be there.

items.en: Hey, Sam, the pharmacy's closing soon. Can we call now?
items.jp: ねえサム、薬局がもうすぐ閉まる。今電話できる？
items.speak: Hey, Sam, the pharmacy's closing soon. Can we call now?

items.en: Yeah, I'll put it on speaker so we can both listen.
items.jp: うん、二人で聞けるようスピーカーにするね。
items.speak: Yeah, I'll put it on speaker so we can both listen.

items.en: Hey, doc, I'm not sure I understood the next steps.
items.jp: 先生、次にすることを理解できたか自信がありません。
items.speak: Hey, doc, I'm not sure I understood the next steps.

items.en: No worries. Could you tell me which part you'd like me to explain again?
items.jp: 大丈夫ですよ。どの部分をもう一度説明しましょうか？
items.speak: No worries. Could you tell me which part you'd like me to explain again?

items.en: Hey, Jen, I kinda lost track of what they said after the test.
items.jp: ねえジェン、検査の後に言われたことをちょっと忘れちゃった。
items.speak: Hey, Jen, I kind of lost track of what they said after the test.
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:少し控えめに言う

items.en: Let's check your notes before we call them back.
items.jp: 折り返し電話する前にメモを確認しよう。
items.speak: Let's check your notes before we call them back.

items.en: Hey, Nina, the bus is here. Need a hand with your bag?
items.jp: ねえニナ、バスが来たよ。バッグ持とうか？
items.speak: Hey, Nina, the bus is here. Need a hand with your bag?

items.en: Thanks. It's heavier than it looks.
items.jp: ありがとう。見た目より重いんだ。
items.speak: Thanks. It's heavier than it looks.

items.en: Hey, folks, does anyone know where the check-in desk moved?
items.jp: みなさん、受付がどこに移ったか分かりますか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, does anyone know where the check-in desk moved?

items.en: It's down the hall, across from the lab.
items.jp: 廊下の先、検査室の向かいです。
items.speak: It's down the hall, across from the lab.

items.en: Hey, Chris, I gotta pick up my prescription before six.
items.jp: ねえクリス、6時までに処方薬を受け取らなきゃ。
items.speak: Hey, Chris, I've got to pick up my prescription before six.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: I'll drive. You can call ahead on the way.
items.jp: 車を出すよ。向かいながら先に電話しておいて。
items.speak: I'll drive. You can call ahead on the way.

items.en: Hey, doctor, could you spell that name for me?
items.jp: 先生、その名前のつづりを教えていただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, doctor, could you spell that name for me?

items.en: Sure. I'll write it on the visit summary too.
items.jp: もちろん。診察内容の書類にも書いておきます。
items.speak: Sure. I'll write it on the visit summary too.

items.en: Hey, Mara, the appointment's at three, not two thirty.
items.jp: ねえマラ、予約は2時半じゃなくて3時だよ。
items.speak: Hey, Mara, the appointment's at three, not two thirty.

items.en: You're kidding. I wrote it down wrong.
items.jp: うそでしょ。書き間違えてた。
items.speak: You're kidding. I wrote it down wrong.

items.en: Hey, Mom, didja bring your list of questions?
items.jp: ねえお母さん、質問のメモ持ってきた？
items.speak: Hey, Mom, did you bring your list of questions?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:持ち物を確認する

items.en: It's in my coat pocket. Gimme a sec.
items.jp: コートのポケットにあるよ。ちょっと待って。
items.speak: It's in my coat pocket. Give me a second.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: Hey, Alex, wanna grab a seat while we wait?
items.jp: ねえアレックス、待っている間座らない？
items.speak: Hey, Alex, want to grab a seat while we wait?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に誘う

items.en: Sounds good. Standing's getting old.
items.jp: いいね。立ってるのもしんどくなってきた。
items.speak: Sounds good. Standing's getting old.

items.en: Hey, nurse, could you check whether my contact number is right?
items.jp: 看護師さん、連絡先の番号が合っているか確認していただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, nurse, could you check whether my contact number is right?

items.en: Sure. Read it back to me, and I'll confirm it.
items.jp: もちろん。番号を読み上げてください。確認します。
items.speak: Sure. Read it back to me, and I'll confirm it.
